'''Magnetite''' is an [[ore]] of [[iron]]. It appears as large, oval-shaped [[Vein|cluster]]s inside [[sedimentary layer]]s. A magnetite cluster may sometimes contain [[vein]]s of [[native platinum]], which can continue outside of the cluster itself.

In terms of [[Metalsmith|metalsmithing]], magnetite is identical to [[hematite]] and [[limonite]]. However, magnetite is distinguished by the extreme size of each deposit compared to the other iron ores - while a vein might hold 100 tiles of ore, a cluster can contain around 750.

==In the real world==
Magnetite is the most magnetic of all the naturally occurring minerals.  It is often found in the form of [[black sand]].
